{{Otheruses|Circle}}
The '''Circle of Rest''' was a place in the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive [[Saras]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Woteba]], where [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]] spoke with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[36 ABY]]. It consisted of four [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-shaped monoliths arrayed in a semicircle with the open side facing the [[Garden Hall]]. Each of the monoliths had sheets of [[Water/Legends|water]] rippling down the sides, and a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a smiling [[Joiner]] child or pucker-mouthed Killik [[Larva/Legends|larva]] looking out from the inside.
